commits.summary: example-targets Phase 5 step 1: every claim task of 285-287, 305 and 306, and 105's two preservation tasks, queued as native strict proof jobs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Step 1 of Phase 5 attempts each deep packet's claim tasks once through the merged path. All 25 claim plans were checked offline with build.py --plan NNN --task T and are executable; 24 jobs are queued: 285's four (vulnerable/fixed security on Boot 2.7.17/2.7.18's WebMvcTags.method, preservation, the mutant), 286's six (DataBinder.isAllowed and bind on Framework 5.3.18/5.3.19, preservation, the mutant), 287's six (BCryptPasswordEncoder.matches and the BCrypt.checkpw byte guard on Security 6.3.7/6.3.8, preservation, the mutant), 305's four on the user's source slice, 306's preservation and mutant-preservation on spring-core 5.3.6/5.3.7, and 105's regression and confined-change. 307's preservation is not queued: its plan is executable but its preparation stops at the Gradle route the user still has to choose. Each job states its expected conclusion and the stop this loop predicts (library-interface arguments for 285 and 305, the DataBinder receiver for 286, String conversion and the encoder receiver for 287); a capability refusal exits 1 with an unresolved receipt and is read as an observed gap, never a pass. The four replays queued last cycle have finished as passed and await collection.

Jobs: 20261114-234211-example-285-vulnerable-security-phase-5, 20261114-234211-example-285-fixed-security-phase-5-step, 20261114-234211-example-285-preservation-phase-5-step-1, 20261114-234211-example-285-mutant-security-phase-5-step, 20261114-234211-example-286-vulnerable-security-phase-5, 20261114-234212-example-286-fixed-security-phase-5-step, 20261114-234212-example-286-preservation-phase-5-step-1, 20261114-234212-example-286-vulnerable-protected-state-m, 20261114-234212-example-286-fixed-protected-state-mutati, 20261114-234212-example-286-mutant-security-phase-5-step, 20261114-234212-example-287-vulnerable-security-phase-5, 20261114-234212-example-287-fixed-security-phase-5-step, 20261114-234213-example-287-preservation-phase-5-step-1, 20261114-234213-example-287-vulnerable-guard-phase-5-ste, 20261114-234213-example-287-fixed-guard-phase-5-step-1-b, 20261114-234213-example-287-mutant-security-phase-5-step, 20261114-234213-example-305-preservation-phase-5-step-1, 20261114-234213-example-305-finite-outcome-before-phase, 20261114-234213-example-305-finite-outcome-after-phase-5, 20261114-234213-example-305-mutant-preservation-phase-5, 20261114-234213-example-306-preservation-phase-5-step-1, 20261114-234214-example-306-mutant-preservation-phase-5, 20261114-234214-example-105-regression-phase-5-step-1-ar, 20261114-234214-example-105-confined-change-phase-5-step.

commits.summary: example-targets Phase 5 step 3: A1, A2 and A6 pass on the real packets; a target's blockers reach every task's handoff; A7's isolated session queued its job (verification pending)
commits.body:
The joint acceptance on the merged revision, from the receipts already in the tree. A new offline test, examples/tools/targets/test_acceptance.py (13 tests), checks three rows over the 20 sidecar examples and the 15 receipts. A1: every task plans and hands off with no network, process or write, and discovery equals the committed index. A2: every receipt names its commits, its JDK release files and the classpath in order, the same in the claim and in each JVM record, on JDK 21 and 25, with each published JAR a sidecar pin. A6: every receipt passes check_result, attempts and claims stay distinct, and execution, conclusion, expectation, scope and replay stay separate fields. The four replays collected in mtvwvktk (105 replay, 285-287 mutant-replay) were read, and all are as expected.

A1 found a defect, fixed with a reproducer: workflow.task_blockers dropped any blocker that names no task. Discovery reads such a blocker as the whole target's. So 307's predicted Gradle build blocker was in none of its handoffs, and 305's and 307's predicted gaps were missing from the gap inventory. Now a target's blocker applies to every task, a capability-kind one only to the tasks that run the verifier. test_workflow.py's test_a_blocker_naming_no_task_is_the_targets and test_acceptance.py's blocker test both fail on the old code. target.schema.json describes the omitted task. The index is unchanged.

A7: an isolated subagent was given only 105 fix-property-before's exported handoff. All 6 inputs matched their sha256, and the plan matched the packet field by field (claim key 8a4071f6a417d239). It queued job 20261114-235737-example-105-task-fix-property-before-the with the packet's own command, expecting the same refutation, pow(-2, 31). A7 passes when that job comes back as expected. Its four observations (a property receipt's replay field is null; a witness names its classes 'after'; the receipt's claim.id differs from the claim key; records/pow-gaps.json isn't a handoff input) are for the for-review list.
